hero.title: Hi, I'm Tomas Morales
hero.subtitle: Staff Engineer at Alpha Anywhere, building the software behind next generation education. I own the technical direction across our learner and parent products and lead the architecture for the long term. Former CTO, 10+ years shipping products.

about.title: About Me
about.bio: I'm an engineer who likes building the hard parts and owning where the technology goes. After 10 years shipping 50+ products as an engineer and CTO, then a year on AI content pipelines at Alpha and a short founder chapter with Arbor Learning, I joined Alpha Anywhere full time. I'm here for the long run: setting the technical direction across our software, leading the architecture, and building a platform that gives students and parents the best possible experience.

philosophy.title: What I Believe
philosophy.quote1: Great teams build fast because they trust deeply.
philosophy.quote2: Impact, clarity, and the craft of building matter most.
philosophy.quote3: Build on solid pillars, not on whatever is fastest today.

about.funFact: When I'm not building, I'm surfing, cycling, or splitboarding in the Andes.

blog.title: Blog
blog.intro: I write about building AI products, education systems, and human performance.

posts.title: AI Won't Steal Our Jobs — It'll Give Us Our Time Back
posts.excerpt: AI is already taking repetitive work off our hands. But something different comes with it—AI makes people incredibly productive. What if we finally reach a point where work stops consuming our whole life?

posts.title: Ship Faster by Knowing When NOT to Use AI
posts.excerpt: The fastest way to real impact with AI isn't a clever prompt — it's knowing where AI excels, where it fails, and where to go deterministic. Use strong exemplars, a stable spec, and ruthless validation.

posts.title: The Truth About AI Engineers (From an ex-CTO)
posts.excerpt: AI hasn't made learning easier for engineers—they just face different lessons now. The best engineers today use AI as a force multiplier, not a crutch.

items.name: Amanda Shipka
items.title: Chief Product Officer @ Alpha Anywhere
items.quote: I had the pleasure of working alongside Tomas at Alpha, and he's someone I'd recommend without hesitation. He's a genuinely talented engineer who delivers high-quality work fast, but what really sets him apart is his character. He's one of the kindest, most team-oriented people I've worked with. He was always the first to offer help, even when something wasn't his responsibility. He's also deeply passionate about education, and it's no surprise he's now building tools to help students succeed. Any team would be lucky to have him.
